name: Earshot
summary: A music player whose volume slider tells you how loud that level really is in decibels
about: A small music player with a live synth tune, a seek bar and a volume slider. As you drag the volume, a springy bubble shows the estimated sound level, compares it to everyday sounds and tells you how long it is safe to listen. Good for music apps, headphone shops and hearing health pages.
how: Press play to start a generated tune; the cover breathes with the beat
Drag the volume slider or use the arrow keys; a bubble swings after the thumb on a spring
The panel counts up the estimated decibels and compares them to a library, traffic or a concert
The meter lights up, turns amber and red, and shows the safe listening time per day
Loud levels show a warning, and the mute button silences the sound and the rings
